newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi beheads man for raping, killing boy.
newsitem.headline: Saudi beheads man for raping, killing boy.

text.p: Saudi Arabia beheaded a Saudi man on Tuesday for raping and killing a three-year-old boy, Saudi state television reported.

It quoted an interior ministry statement as saying the man kidnapped the boy, raped and killed him. The man then dumped the boy's body in a lake. He also tried to abduct another boy but was caught by the police, it added. It gave no further details.
The beheading in the eastern city of Khobar brought to 49 the number of people executed in Saudi Arabia this year.
The conservative kingdom strictly enforces Islamic law by publicly beheading by the sword convicted murderers, drug smugglers, rapists and other criminals.
